fusions.name: Tamping Block
fusions.desc: Hurls a tamping block at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 14 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedded Flat
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Compacted Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
